label: License
description: Groups real-world, SPDX-ish license strings into coarse families (MIT, GPL, LGPL, BSD, Apache, ...) so notation drift across sources ("GPL3" vs "GPL-3.0-or-later") doesn't read as a conflict. Not an SPDX validator or a full SPDX-expression parser, and never used to pick or display a license — only to compare two reported strings for "same family".
